lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: Since you brought the gate drone down they count us every night. Used to be once a quarter and a form.

lines.speaker: pell
lines.text: Tonight the count came early and it brought a man with it. That has not happened in my lifetime and my lifetime is most of this village's.

choices.text: Then it is the last count.
Let them count. A count is only a number.
